scope: CPU saved-input diagnostics; no new RF, no production campaign, no commit/push

matched_control.model: Filter transition and Q, independent measurements; odom-heading disabled; separate exact affine scalar oracle

factorial.sensor: legacy SensorNoise with low drift, same inputs/prior/noise per seed
factorial.synthetic_R: range sigma^2+quant_var+extra_sigma^2; s scalar legacy route mismatch^2; thermal noise zero

conditional.embargo: middle 20%; remove any evaluation pose_id appearing in calibration
conditional.evaluation: R2 final 40%, t>=30s, unique calibration pose_ids excluded
conditional.prior: same narrow legacy prior at original route start; no truth during updates
conditional.fallback: distance -> constant calibration RMS outside support/undersampled bins
conditional.phase_definition: abs(((estimated body heading deg + mount deg +45) mod90)-45); antenna yaw phase relative fixed world axes, not measured polarization matching
conditional.oracle: truth features for residual analysis only

statistics.units: independent noise seeds conditional on one fixed RF route; time samples NOT independent replicates
statistics.nees: pose 3 dof, two-sided individual chi2 2.5/97.5% tails plus 95% coverage; seed summaries and bootstrap
statistics.adoption: exploratory only; joint accuracy+uncertainty required, no inherited NEES<=6 gate; no scientific PASS promotion
statistics.criterion: paired heading AND position median delta upper bootstrap CI <=0; NEES seed-mean CI contains 3, median 95% pose coverage in [0.90,0.99], each two-sided 95% tail <=0.05; residual autocorr remains a limitation

missing_inputs_policy: Record UNKNOWN / NOT INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED for absent FFD/LoS-only raw/traces/other route/anchor/mount; do not synthesize RF substitutes
